meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 把 Tavily 的搜索和网页提取装成 Agent 可用的工具,无需 API 密钥;同时写好免费额度用尽时引导升级付费密钥的说明。
howto.when: 当你想给某个 NanoClaw 的 agent 组装上 Tavily 网络搜索或网页提取,而又不想提供 API 密钥时触发。

say.text: 给 test 组安装 Tavily 搜索和网页提取工具
帮我给 codex 组加上 Tavily,不用 API 密钥
给所有组装 Tavily,并在额度用尽时提示升级

howto.what_en: Installs Tavily Search and Extract as tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups without an API key, and sets up upgrade guidance when the free allowance runs out.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add Tavily web search or URL extraction to a NanoClaw agent group without providing an API key.

say_en.text: Install Tavily search and extract tools for the test group
Add Tavily to the codex group without an API key
Set up Tavily for all groups and prompt upgrade when quota is spent
